reviews.title: Great way to connect and stay in touch
reviews.text:
I have been playing WordFeud for years. I have 6 simultaneous games going with family and friends - great way to stay in touch while exercising your brain.

The ads only come after you make your move, so they don't interrupt game play, and it's only 1 ad that you can skip after a couple seconds.

Each player has up to 72 hours to make their move, so you just do it when you feel like it, in the background of your life. If you want to play more, you can play with random opponents.

In the course of my time playing there have been a couple words that I think should have been in their dictionary, and I think there are too many "I"'s, but overall it's a fun app that I will continue to enjoy.
